description: This PHP source file defines the TimeConfigPeriodAPI class, a REST API endpoint in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods to get and update the timesheet period configuration, including retrieving the current start day and setting a new start day for timesheets. The class uses various services and validators, and adheres to OpenAPI specifications for documentation.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing the timesheet period configuration, including retrieval and updating of start day parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current timesheet period start day; defaults to '1' if not set, and returns a TimeConfigPeriodModel encapsulating this data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Specifies validation rules for the GET request, excluding the 'id' parameter from validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the timesheet period start day based on client input, enabling relevant menu items afterward, and returns the updated period data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the update request, ensuring the period is not already defined, and the 'startDay' parameter is between 1 and 7.
